storage: about 6 months; freezer: up to a year. Soaked almonds keep 2–3 days in the fridge.
looksLike: Flat, teardrop-shaped kernels about 2–2.5 cm long, with a thin, ridged, light-brown skin and a creamy-white inside. California almonds are fairly uniform and smooth; Indian-grown or Mamra almonds are smaller, more curved and rougher.
shelfLife: About 6–12 months in a sealed pack; 2–3 months once opened at room temperature in Mumbai's humidity.

usedIn.raw: 8 g (6 almonds, chopped), stirred in the night before
